title: Learning to Walk
subtitle: Bipedal Robot Locomotion Using Reinforcement Learning
description: Deep RL with actor–critic algorithms (DDPG, TD3, SAC) plus a PD controller to learn stable, energy-efficient walking in continuous action spaces.
details: Trained in simulation with sensory feedback for smooth, terrain-adaptive humanoid locomotion.
Balanced dynamic stability and energy efficiency across a complex control environment.

title: Cold Email Generator
subtitle: End-to-End Generative AI Tool
description: Full-stack GenAI system that automates personalized cold-email outreach for software and AI service companies.
details: Used LLaMA 3.1 with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (ChromaDB + LangChain) for context-aware, tailored emails.
Built a Flask front end for entering industry, service offerings, and tone preferences.

title: SQL Chatbot
subtitle: Generative AI-based Natural Language → SQL
description: An AI-powered chatbot that turns natural-language requests into complex SQL queries, improving query efficiency by 60%.
details: Interpreted user intent with ML to generate precise SQL for 50+ queries a day.
Refined the model on 10,000+ query variations to boost accuracy and UX.
